author: Codex handwritten procedures; deterministic formatting variants; no optimizer generation
purpose: Measure these four self-contained procedures and their paragraph/structured layouts on fixed Train400
format_invariant: Same card order, meta and when_to_use; same operative text and order. S adds only Purpose/Procedure/Evidence/Stop headings, 1..4 markers and newlines.
content_change_from_private_draft: Each original intro and steps1..5 remain verbatim. One Evidence sentence per card is inserted between original steps4 and5 in both variants. No tool-format compression.

token_measurement.reason: Local stdlib preparation has no tokenizer; no tokenizer/dependency installation is authorized here.
token_measurement.required_before_result_interpretation: Record P/S when_to_use, strategy and rendered strategy token lengths with the frozen 9B Actor tokenizer. Actual per-request tokens remain recorded by the runner.

execution_order.first: Run canonical first40 questions for both P and S as an execution/routing diagnostic; these80 rollouts are part of800.
execution_order.then: Complete the fixed remaining360 questions for each variant without selecting variants or stopping from prefix scores.
execution_order.on_infrastructure_failure: Preserve evidence, repair the execution failure, and resume missing units only; never replace panel members or repeat successful results.

baseline.policy: Read-only reuse of completed matching Train400 empty results; never regenerate or score an empty baseline.

runtime.actor_and_judge_protocol: Same frozen8ff source, numeric/media/budget/score contracts as completed Train400 baseline; verify actual identity, do not patch Actor.
runtime.selection: Natural one card or none for each role; none remains legal; no forced injection or activation quota.

primary_readouts: S minus reused empty on all400
P minus reused empty on all400
secondary_readout: S minus P on all400: layout difference for this fixed four-procedure library only.
statistics: Use the existing official ten-task macro and CCQA point denominators over all400; retain paired regressions/repairs, source-group sensitivity and actual per-request tokens. Do not average shard scores.
scope_limits: Train development measurement; handwritten text uses prior legal Train qualitative gaps, not an independent confirmation.
No conclusion about all skill writing styles, library granularity, arbitrary tasks or universal utility.
Same operative sentences do not guarantee identical model interpretation or outputs; heading/marker token overhead is not controlled away.
Two methods per role are this input design, not a prescribed taxonomy or future library quota.
Overlap is legal; selection may choose either applicable method or none. Activation is not accuracy.
No held cases used in applicability review; synthetic counterexamples are fictional, not empirical transfer evidence.
prior_Gate: Already used for the prior ABC winner confirmation and rejected; unavailable to this package.
